Ingredients

Pasta (durum wheat semolina pasta, water, canola oil), Water, Green beans, Wax beans, Carrots, Crushed tomatoes (tomatoes, salt, naturally derived citric acid), Onions, Modified starch, Canola oil, Balsamic vinegar (wine vinegar, concentrated grape must, caramel colour), Vegetable seasoning (salt, dehydrated vegetables, sugar, spices (includes celery), herbs, colour (paprika)), Basil , Garlic (water, garlic, canola oil, citric acid), Salt, Xanthan gum, White pepper.
